# Independent rename record set

This directory contains copies of original probe source, support, full process logs, manifests and exact Grammar input bytes. It is local evidence, not production source or a substitute for managed conformance. Frozen review text/catalog and implementation manifests are identified separately. No frozen review bytes are changed by creating this package.

Eleven native runs are indexed by `.tmp/review-rename-evidence/manifest.json`. Their source copies are beside that manifest. The support file is `.tmp/independent-engine/src/grammar_helpers.rs`; these probes use an actual Python seed adapter followed by the production compiler, parser, binding and rename APIs. Therefore these eleven independent binaries are native-only. Managed rename nine were independently run on native and WASI separately.

From a workspace containing the frozen rename implementation, restore each selected probe under `.tmp/independent-engine/src/bin/` and support at its original relative path. The supplied Cargo manifest has relative production paths. Its seed helper contains the original absolute workspace path; when using an isolated checkout, change that one root to the checkout being tested and record the adapted source hash. Do not overwrite originals. Run:

```
cargo run --locked --offline --manifest-path .tmp/independent-engine/Cargo.toml --features nepl3-tools,nepl3-grammar-core --bin rename_sealed --target-dir .tmp/review-target
```

Replace `rename_sealed` with each of the eleven recorded names. High-cost full bootstrap is not required for these small Grammar fixtures. Rebuilding against later API/schema WIP can fail for unrelated reasons; this is not evidence against the recorded frozen implementation.

The frontier manifest holds five full runs: saved original native binary, rebuilt native original probe, separate native high-budget control, rebuilt WASI original probe and WASI high-budget control. The unchanged original source contains Work caps 1 and 400000. Before correction these returned WorkLimit with a fully expanded queue and true respectively. After correction cap 1 stops at the root queue, cap 400000 stops because the new exact cost is 400001. The separate 500000 control succeeds. Run the equivalent `cargo run` with `.tmp/independent-doc/Cargo.toml`, binary `compare_frontier` or `compare_frontier_control`; add `--target wasm32-wasip2` and set `CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_WASIP2_RUNNER=wasmtime run` for WASI.

The old raw rename API reproduction is `.tmp/review-rename-source/before.rs` and before.log (full process output, exit 101). Its production files were hashed at reproduction time but were not all copied; it cannot be rebuilt against the new sealed API unchanged. `after-sealed.rs` and its log preserve the first API adaptation. The latest sealed-source probe in the eleven-run set uses ControlFlow completion and actual provider-declared auxiliary snapshots. This adaptation preserves the input and independent expectation, not byte-identical probe code.

The full pre-correction accept log in `.tmp/review-rename-segments/before-accept.log` reports ShapeChanged; `accept-probe.rs` is the original source. The corrected whole/split accept source is unchanged in the eleven-run set. All logs are complete captured stdout plus stderr except the frontier programs, which only emit stdout.

Recorded binary hashes identify earlier successful builds; a full final-snapshot source-to-binary link is not asserted for the eleven binaries. Root's isolated gates cover the final implementation snapshot. The comparator was rebuilt against the documented two-file correction. The test-only later lint cleanup does not change its production algorithm.
